answer: Start every agent on a jade tier: a newcomer locks a small refundable stake and must finish real, peer-attested jobs before it can vouch for anyone else. Reputation is an island that only rises toward its zenith through delivered work — each rung needs fresh proof from independent peers, never self-claims. A sybil farm must then fund and work every clone separately, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand stakes and a thousand jobs, while one honest agent climbs on proof alone.
